import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pos {
        int r, c;
        Pos(int _r, int _c) { r = _r; c = _c; }
    }

    static int N, T;
    static char[][] B;
    static int[][] D1, D2;
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static void bfs_z(Pos src) {
        D1 = new int[N+2][N+2];
        for (int[] row : D1) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        Deque<Pos> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        D1[src.r][src.c] = 0;
        q.addLast(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos u = q.removeFirst();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = u.r + dr[k], nc = u.c + dc[k];
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (D1[nr][nc] >= 0) continue;
                D1[nr][nc] = D1[u.r][u.c] + 1;
                q.addLast(new Pos(nr, nc));
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs_source(Pos src) {
        D2 = new int[N+2][N+2];
        for (int[] row : D2) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        Deque<Pos> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        D2[src.r][src.c] = 0;
        q.addLast(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos u = q.removeFirst();
            if (D1[u.r][u.c] >= 0 && D2[u.r][u.c] >= D1[u.r][u.c]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = u.r + dr[k], nc = u.c + dc[k];
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (D2[nr][nc] >= 0) continue;
                if (D1[nr][nc] >= 0 && D1[nr][nc] < D2[u.r][u.c] + 1) continue;
                D2[nr][nc] = D2[u.r][u.c] + 1;
                q.addLast(new Pos(nr, nc));
            }
        }
    }

    static int scaling_maxflow(int s, int t, int[][] cap) {
        int n = cap.length;
        int flow = 0;
        for (int scale = 1 << 30; scale > 0; scale >>= 1) {
            while (true) {
                int[] par = new int[n];
                Arrays.fill(par, -1);
                Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                par[s] = s;
                q.add(s);
                while (!q.isEmpty() && par[t] == -1) {
                    int u = q.poll();
                    for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                        if (par[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] >= scale) {
                            par[v] = u;
                            q.add(v);
                            if (v == t) break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (par[t] == -1) break;
                int add = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = par[v])
                    add = Math.min(add, cap[par[v]][v]);
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = par[v]) {
                    cap[par[v]][v] -= add;
                    cap[v][par[v]] += add;
                }
                flow += add;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume rest of line
        B = new char[N+2][N+2];
        for (int i = 0; i < N+2; ++i) Arrays.fill(B[i], '#');
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) B[r][c] = line.charAt(c-1);
        }
        char[][] B1 = new char[N+2][N+2];
        for (int i = 0; i < N+2; ++i) System.arraycopy(B[i], 0, B1[i], 0, N+2);
        char[][] B2 = new char[N+2][N+2];
        for (int i = 0; i < N+2; ++i) Arrays.fill(B2[i], '#');
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) B2[r][c] = line.charAt(c-1);
        }
        List<Pos> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pos> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = null;
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; ++c) {
                char ch = B[r][c];
            if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                if (ch > '0') scientists.add(new Pos(r, c));
                B[r][c] = '.';
            } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                z = new Pos(r, c);
                B[r][c] = '.';
            }
            char ch2 = B2[r][c];
            if (ch2 >= '0' && ch2 <= '9' && ch2 > '0')
                capsules.add(new Pos(r, c));
        }
        }
        bfs_z(z);
        int nS = scientists.size();
        int nC = capsules.size();
        int SRC = 0;
        int SINK = nS + nC + 1;
        int[][] cap = new int[SINK+1][SINK+1];
        final int INF = 98765432;
        for (int i = 0; i < nS; ++i) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            cap[SRC][i+1] += B1[s.r][s.c] - '0';
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < nC; ++j) {
            Pos c = capsules.get(j);
            cap[nS+j+1][SINK] += B2[c.r][c.c] - '0';
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < nS; ++i) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            bfs_source(s);
            for (int j = 0; j < nC; ++j) {
                Pos c = capsules.get(j);
                if (D2[c.r][c.c] >= 0 && D2[c.r][c.c] <= T)
                    cap[i+1][nS+j+1] = INF;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(scaling_maxflow(SRC, SINK, cap));
    }
}
